integrity: Every four-agent profile and perfect matching is exhausted. Stability, rank-maximality, and minimum regret are each replayed by independent exact implementations, and disagreement profiles are canonicalized under every agent relabeling.
scientific_limitations: The classification is exact only for complete strict Stable Roommates instances with two and four agents; no larger-market frequency formula is claimed.
title: Sharp four-agent conflict between rank-maximal and minimum-regret stable roommates
